depth_history.shortcut_targeted: The small fixed maximum of 46 vertices makes exact independent-set search with Python integer bitmasks and DFS feasible.
depth_history.edit_summary: Because the 46-vertex bound is immutable, change the acceptance wording from allowing any valid group to requiring a canonical valid group, such as the lexicographically smallest one. This removes the survivor's ability to stop at the first DFS witness and requires substantially more search.

resistant_to: Uses integer bitmasks and branch-and-bound-style DFS, which is practical for a graph of at most 46 vertices and can stop at the first valid group.
